name: self assisted inverted pullover
description: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.
